from pathlib import Path
import sys,json,subprocess,hashlib
S=Path('/workspace/scratch/wi1088-runtime-continuity')
name,package,*rest=sys.argv[1:]
args=['test','--locked','--package',package,*rest]
common=['verify','--work-item','WI-1088-runtime-activation-amendment-continuity-recovery','--command','cargo',*[('--args='+a) for a in args],'--workers','1']
def observe(label,arguments):
 p=subprocess.run(['python3',str(S/'observe.py'),label,*arguments])
 if p.returncode: raise SystemExit(p.returncode)
 return json.loads((S/'commands'/(label+'.stdout')).read_text())
st=observe(name+'-admission',['work-item','status','--id','WI-1088-runtime-activation-amendment-continuity-recovery','--json'])
if 'run_verification' not in st['safeActions']: raise SystemExit('Native verification admission is not current: '+json.dumps(st['actionExplanation']))
observe(name+'-validate',['work-item','validate','--id','WI-1088-runtime-activation-amendment-continuity-recovery','--json'])
receipt=Path('/workspace/ai-cockpit-wi1088-runtime-continuity/.ai/evidence/WI-1088-runtime-activation-amendment-continuity-recovery.verification.json')
(S/'commands'/(name+'-receipt-inventory.json')).write_text(json.dumps({'kind':'agent_read_only_receipt_inventory_not_native_receipt','canonicalPresent':receipt.exists(),'canonicalRawSha256':hashlib.sha256(receipt.read_bytes()).hexdigest() if receipt.exists() else None,'reuseAuthority':'only the following native plan can admit reuse; this inventory grants none'},indent=2)+'\n')
p=observe(name+'-plan',common+['--plan-only'])
if p['nodesToExecute']!=1 or p['processesSpawned']!=0 or p['plannedNodes'][0]['timeoutSeconds']!=600: raise SystemExit('Unexpected plan; refusing execution: '+json.dumps(p))
print(json.dumps({'nativePlanAccepted':True,'nodeCount':1,'timeoutSeconds':600,'package':package,'args':args}),flush=True)
observe(name+'-execute',common)
